purpose: Teach: 遊べる/ビリ/チャリ/脇役/最上/名残/グマ/少なめ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、昔、川で遊べる時、楽しかった?
lines.en: Grandpa, back when you were young — did you have fun playing in the river?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious. Leans forward slightly. Not demanding an answer, but eager to know this particular thing about him. The small pause before 'fun' shows he's choosing his words carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。マラソン、ビリで、皆に笑われたな、私、若い頃。
lines.en: Yeah. I came in last in the marathon — everyone laughed at me back then.
lines.style: Quiet, almost to himself. A small, distant smile in the voice. Not sad, just — remembering. The words land like he's pulling them from somewhere deep and unrushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんも、チャリ、得意だって。
lines.en: Dad's good at riding his bike too.
lines.style: Bright connection-making. A little proud of the observation he's just shared. Speaking to himself as much as to Grandpa — testing out the link he's noticed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、芝居でも、脇役、好きだったよ。
lines.en: My father — he even liked being in the background when they did plays.
lines.style: Warm recollection. Slight emphasis on 'background' — not dismissive, but exact. Like he's appreciating something quiet about that choice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: マンション、最上階、空が見えてすごい!
lines.en: The top floor of the apartment — you can see the sky from up there. It's incredible.
lines.style: Genuine awe breaking through. A little breathless on 'incredible.' Sho is not performing wonder — he's actually struck by it, and letting Grandpa in on that feeling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 戦後の名残、私の世代、まだ覚えている。
lines.en: The way things were after the war — my generation still remembers all of that.
lines.style: Measured, looking inward. Not explaining, just — stating what he knows to be true. A kind of quiet weight behind the words, but no heaviness in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃんが、若い頃、アライグマ、見たことある?
lines.en: Did you ever see a raccoon when you were young, Grandpa?
lines.style: Direct and eager — the question tumbles out genuinely. Sho wants to know this. Real curiosity, not performing interest. A small energy shift.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 夜のご飯、少なめにしてるよ、最近の私は。
lines.en: I've been eating a little less at dinner lately, to be honest.
lines.style: Gentle turn inward. Matter-of-fact, but with a thread of care underneath — not worry, just the small kindnesses he extends to his own body. A quiet close to the conversation.
